description: This file is a user-level header for the libqhull_r library, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes related to computational geometry operations such as convex hulls and Voronoi diagrams. It includes class and method definitions for facets, ridges, vertices, and global variables used in qhull computations.

classes.name: facetT
classes.description: Represents a facet of the convex hull, including geometric and topological information, flags for state, and pointers to vertices, ridges, and neighbors.

classes.name: ridgeT
classes.description: Defines a ridge (edge) between facets, including vertices, neighboring facets, and flags for convexity and duplication.

classes.name: vertexT
classes.description: Represents a vertex with geometric coordinates, adjacency to facets, and flags for deletion and processing state.

classes.name: qhT
classes.description: Contains all global variables, configuration flags, constants, and state information used throughout the qhull library.

methods.name: otherfacet_
methods.description: Returns the neighboring facet for a given ridge in a facet.

methods.name: getid_
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for a facet, ridge, or vertex.

methods.name: qh_qhull
methods.description: Main function to compute the convex hull using qhull.

methods.name: qh_addpoint
methods.description: Adds a new point to the hull, checking distances and updating structures.

methods.name: qh_errexit
methods.description: Handles errors and exits during qhull processing.

methods.name: qh_printsummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of qhull statistics.

methods.name: qh_findbest
methods.description: Finds the best facet for a given point, used in hull construction.
